Do not use a catheter valve when the bladder needs continuous drainage, such as with significant cognitive impairment, poor manual dexterity, severe urinary retention risk, or when accurate fluid balance monitoring is required. Avoid it during urinary tract infection, hematuria, or when the patient cannot reliably open the valve. Also avoid it if the patient or caregivers cannot manage it safely or if the urine output is very high.
